narrative:

Your first-year standing was the second most influential factor: also the lowest decile versus an accepted average near the sixth decile, it also pushed toward failure. Your undergraduate GPA of 3.50 was the third most important factor and pushed toward passing, since it is above the accepted average of 3.23, but it was not enough to offset the class-standing signals.
